title: Bluegate Rental Terms: Multiple Units and Reservation Limits under the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Clause.** A customer may rent any number of storage units; each unit is its own Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement with its own ledger, its own due date and its own lien schedule. A customer may hold at most **3** open reservations at one time. Every other rental agreement in the customer's name must be in reserved, active, moving out, vacated, reservation cancelled or sold at lien sale status before a new reservation is taken; a customer with a delinquent, lien noticed or auction scheduled rental must bring that rental current first. A reservation is made only on a unit the facility inventory shows as available.

## What each condition reads

| Condition | Record that decides it | When it is read |
|---|---|---|
| Open reservations below the limit | the number of the customer's rental agreements in reserved status on the handling date, counted before the new reservation is made; that number must leave room under the limit of 3 | before the reservation is taken |
| Standing of the customer's other agreements | the status of every other rental agreement in the customer's name, as the company's records show it | before the reservation is taken |
| Unit available | the facility inventory's availability for the specific unit to be reserved | before the reservation is taken |

The number of units a customer may rent carries no cap. The standing of the other agreements is taken from the company's own records, matched to the customer by the customer's identity on each agreement.

## Status check at a glance

| Status of another agreement in the customer's name | New reservation may be taken |
|---|---|
| reserved, active, moving out, vacated, reservation cancelled, sold at lien sale | yes, as far as this condition goes |
| delinquent, lien noticed, auction scheduled | no — that rental is first brought current |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical customers)

- A customer already holding 2 agreements in reserved status may take a third reservation, all other conditions being met; a customer already holding 3 may not take a fourth.
- A customer with one active unit and one vacated unit, asking for a reservation on a unit the inventory shows as available, meets the status and availability conditions.
- A customer whose second unit is lien noticed does not have a new reservation taken while that rental stands in that status, however many units the customer rents.
